title: kb/_self/map.csv maps token-efficiency.md to every module its Model call sites section names
goal: Each _tools module the Model call sites section of kb/_self/token-efficiency.md names (bl_dispatch, census, factdiff, kb_ask, kbask, ql_distill, ql_research) has a map.csv row to that doc, so selfdoc.py stale flags the section when one of them changes

run:
import sys,csv
rows={(r[0],r[1]) for r in csv.reader(open('kb/_self/map.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if len(r)>1}
miss=[m for m in ('bl_dispatch','census','factdiff','kb_ask','kbask','ql_distill','ql_research') if ('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md','_tools/'+m+'.py') not in rows]
print('unmapped:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
